morphology.pattern_note: 整词处理；人名通常写作 Thorin。输入缺少语境，无法确定指人名还是化学试剂；不作马来语词缀拆分。

senses.zh_definition: 索林：人名；文学语境中可指托尔金《霍比特人》中的矮人首领索林·橡木盾。
senses.en_definition: A personal name; in Tolkien's The Hobbit, the name of the dwarf leader Thorin Oakenshield.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang; dalam karya The Hobbit oleh J. R. R. Tolkien, nama pemimpin kumpulan orang kerdil yang dikenali sebagai Thorin Oakenshield.
senses.nuances: 词类细分为专有名词，规范书写首字母大写。输入不能证明它特指该角色，故保留人名与化学名称两种解释。下列为名称及语境组合，不是经频次验证的固定搭配。释义为编辑撰写，非 DBP 官方引文；IPA 与官方马来语词条资格均未核实。频率排名沿用输入数据。[University of the Highlands and Islands](https://www.uhi.ac.uk/en/research-enterprise/cultural/institute-for-northern-studies/blogs--exhibitions/old-mimirs-well-articles/rings-dwarves-elves-and-dragons-j-r-r-tolkiens-old-norse-influences/)

senses.zh_definition: 钍试剂：一种含砷偶氮染料，可用作硫酸根滴定的指示剂。
senses.en_definition: An arsenic-containing azo dye used as an indicator in sulfate titration.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis pewarna azo yang mengandungi arsenik dan digunakan sebagai penunjuk dalam pentitratan sulfat.
senses.nuances: 化学名称，与文学人名不是同一义源。试剂厂商列有 CAS 3688-92-4 的产品；此处依据产品资料解释，不据此声称 thorin 是 DBP 核定的马来语术语。下列为专业语境组合。[Merck: Thorin](https://www.merckmillipore.com/IL/en/product/mm/108294)

dual_scenarios.ms: Laporan makmal menyatakan bahawa thorin digunakan sebagai penunjuk dalam pentitratan sulfat.
dual_scenarios.zh: 实验室报告指出，该硫酸根滴定使用钍试剂作为指示剂。
dual_scenarios.en: The laboratory report states that thorin was used as the indicator in the sulfate titration.

dual_scenarios.zh: 我刚看了索林那一幕。你看过了吗？
dual_scenarios.en: I just watched that scene with Thorin. Have you seen it?

etymology.historical_story: The literary name Thorin belongs to Tolkien's engagement with Old Norse tradition: names associated with his dwarves appear in earlier Norse literature. This gives the character a linguistic history beyond modern fantasy. Separately, thorin names a laboratory indicator; the packet supplies no evidence connecting that chemical designation with the personal name. [University of the Highlands and Islands](https://www.uhi.ac.uk/en/research-enterprise/cultural/institute-for-northern-studies/blogs--exhibitions/old-mimirs-well-articles/rings-dwarves-elves-and-dragons-j-r-r-tolkiens-old-norse-influences/), [Merck](https://www.merckmillipore.com/IL/en/product/mm/108294)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 文学里见 Thorin，联想“索林”；实验室里见 thorin，联想滴定指示剂。靠语境分辨，不把两种来源混为一谈。
